data.name: DION
data.detailed_description:
🚨 OPEN ALPHA — PLAY FOR FREE!

The DION Open Alpha starts today!

Download DION for free and experience the game during our Open Alpha.

📅 August 29 → September 29, 2026
🎮 2 hours of free gameplay
💰 100% free — no purchase required

The Open Alpha is available for one month only and will end on September 29, 2026.

Step into the world of DION, explore a dangerous world, gather resources, take control of houses to establish your territory, craft your equipment, master witchcraft, and fight other players.

DION – A Multiplayer Survival Game Inspired by West African Empires

Step into DION, a multiplayer survival game set in a brutal world inspired by the great West African empires of the 13th century.

Explore, gather, hunt, and fight to survive. In this unforgiving world, your ingenuity, strategy, and strength will determine your fate.

🌍 A PERSISTENT AND RUTHLESS WORLD

Explore rich and diverse landscapes, from vast arid savannas to lush jungles.

Every resource matters. Every encounter can be an opportunity… or a threat.

Discover a living and dangerous world where you must constantly adapt to survive.

🏠 TAKE CONTROL OF YOUR TERRITORY

Discover houses scattered throughout the world and take control of them to establish your presence.

Use the houses you control to store and manage your resources, prepare your equipment, and secure what you have worked hard to obtain.

But beware: territories and resources attract attention. What you control can become a target for other players.

⚒️ GATHER, CRAFT, SURVIVE

Explore the world in search of resources essential to your survival.

Gather materials, store your resources, and craft tools, weapons, and equipment to improve your chances of survival.

Hunt for food, manage your resources, and prepare yourself for the dangers of the world.

⚔️ FIGHT OR COOPERATE

In DION, you are free to choose how you survive.

Form alliances, cooperate with other players, trade resources, or betray your enemies when the opportunity arises.

Defend your territory, attack your opponents, and fight for control of the wild lands.

🔮 MASTER WITCHCRAFT

Discover the secrets of witchcraft and learn to master ancient powers.

Through these powers, you can practice shapeshifting, taking the form of wild or mythical animals.

Use your witchcraft to hunt, explore, fight your enemies, escape danger, or harness unique abilities.

Your ability to master these powers could mean the difference between survival and death.

🔥 A WORLD INSPIRED BY HISTORY AND LEGENDS

Discover a universe inspired by 13th-century West African civilizations, where history, legends, and traditions intertwine with survival and conquest.

Step into a world where ancient beliefs, witchcraft, and the struggle for territory shape your journey.

Survive. Gather. Master Witchcraft. Conquer.

❤️ ENJOYING DION?

If you're enjoying your experience in DION, please consider adding the game to your Steam Wishlist. Your wishlist helps us tremendously and directly supports the development of the game.

📌 Add DION to your Steam Wishlist
📱 Follow us on social media to stay up to date with development, news, updates, and future events.

data.short_description: A survival game set in the heart of the great West African empires. The rules? There are none. Manage your base, craft your tools, gather resources, hunt, and impose your will on other players in this persistent, ruthless, and open world!
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: intel i5 4570 / AMD Ryzen 3 3200G
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 960
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

Recommended:

  • Processor: Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 / RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
